categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in civil aviation transportation, including passenger and cargo air transport services, ground handling services, aircraft maintenance and repair, in-flight catering, laundry and cleaning services, warehousing and logistics, hotel and tourism services, and investment and leasing. It also engages in aircraft leasing and aviation personnel training. The business is diversified across passenger services, cargo services, ground services, and related aviation support industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced aircraft fleets including Airbus A321neo, A350-900/1000, Boeing 777-9, 787-9, and 777F cargo planes, focusing on fleet modernization for fuel efficiency and environmental sustainability. It employs AI, big data analytics, RPA, and digital platforms for operational efficiency, customer service, and cargo management. The company also integrates ISO-certified environmental and information security management systems and develops proprietary digital tools such as AI-powered contract generation, customer service chatbots, and intelligent cargo inspection systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include international and domestic passengers, freight forwarders, express delivery companies, postal services, and general cargo clients. The company serves major markets across Asia-Pacific, North America, Europe, and Oceania, with a focus on connecting Taiwan as a regional hub. It also targets high-value cargo sectors such as semiconductors, AI-related products, pharmaceuticals requiring cold chain logistics, and e-commerce businesses.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations cover 27 countries with 187 passenger destinations and 14 countries with 30 cargo destinations, spanning Asia (including Northeast and Southeast Asia), North America, Europe, and Oceania. The company leverages Taiwan’s strategic location at Taoyuan International Airport as a key transit hub in East Asia. It maintains subsidiaries and offices in Taiwan, mainland China, the United States, and other international locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream player in the aviation supply chain, providing air transportation services for passengers and cargo. It also engages in upstream activities through aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services, and supports supply chain logistics via warehousing and ground handling. It maintains control over key operational assets such as aircraft fleets and ground service equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include fleet modernization with new-generation aircraft to improve fuel efficiency and reduce emissions, expansion and optimization of global route networks, strengthening airline alliances and code-sharing partnerships, and enhancing digital transformation through AI, big data, and automation. The company emphasizes sustainability initiatives such as sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) adoption, carbon reduction targets aligned with SBTi, and environmental management systems. R&D focuses on AI applications in contract automation, customer service, cargo inspection, and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through passenger ticket sales, cargo transportation fees, in-flight duty-free sales, and ancillary services such as ground handling and aircraft maintenance. The company also earns income from investments in subsidiaries and joint ventures related to aviation and logistics. Additional revenue streams include leasing and rental services, and hospitality operations through its hotel subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading national carrier in Taiwan, competing primarily with other Taiwanese airlines such as EVA Air, China Airlines subsidiaries, and low-cost carriers like Tigerair Taiwan and Starlux Airlines. It holds a significant market share in both passenger and cargo segments domestically and maintains a competitive position in the Asia-Pacific region through its membership in the SkyTeam alliance. Its cargo operations are recognized as among the best in Asia, supported by certifications and specialized services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$175.18 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing an 8.35% increase year-over-year, with a net profit after tax of NT$14.38 billion, a significant improvement from the prior year. Total assets reached NT$327.38 billion, up 12.41%, and equity increased by 16.87%. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by fleet expansion, operational efficiency, and market demand recovery post-pandemic.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through a modern and fuel-efficient fleet, extensive global route network, and strong alliance partnerships enhancing connectivity and customer convenience. It emphasizes high-quality passenger experience with upgraded cabin products and digital services, robust cargo capabilities including cold chain logistics certified by IATA CEIV Pharma, and sustainability leadership with science-based carbon reduction targets and SAF initiatives. Its integrated service offerings across passenger, cargo, ground handling, and maintenance create a comprehensive aviation service ecosystem.
